messages:
maria (Sales): Hey team — ACME ready to start a 2-week POC. They want low-friction access for devs but also isolation for sensitive data. Main asks: hosted API keys for quick tests, option to move to a Dedicated pool if perf needed, and a Private/VPC plan if we get an NDA. Can we map next steps?

ajay (SE): +1. Recommended flow: 1) give hosted short-lived API key & workspace invite for initial tests, 2) if latency/throughput looks bad, spin a small Dedicated pool (2x A10G equivalent) as a canary, 3) Private/VPC only if they need inbound controls or air-gapped.

chris (ACME): timeline? we have 4 engineers who need access today. also security questionnaire flagged "no shared creds" requirement.

maria (Sales): they want least-privilege invites. can we do role scoping and expiring keys?

ajay (SE): yes. We can invite users to an ACME workspace and grant them the "developer" role (token creation restricted to service accounts). For quick dev access, we can create a short-lived API key scoped to the workspace and set expiry 48h. Example curl to test hosted endpoint:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer POCPREP_<redacted>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"open-llama-7b", "input":"hello"}'
```

ajay (SE): For Dedicated, provisioning lead time ~24-48h. We'll allocate a reserved pool and give them a dedicated model route.

taylor (Infra): For Private/VPC, we need their CIDR for peering or a list of allowed egress IPs. Common blocker: corporate firewall prevents outbound to our control-plane for auth. If that's the case we run a private controller in their VPC (on prem) but that needs CA and KMS integration.

safiya (Security): From our side: require KMS-backed key for production, RBAC audit enabled, and token rotation. For the POC we can allow short-lived hosted keys but we need an answer on data residency. Also request: no broad org-level "admin" invites — give only two "org-admin" for the customer's security ops.

ajay (SE): Suggested RBAC minimal set for POC:
```
- role: workspace_developer  # can create routes, view logs limited to workspace
- role: service_account_runner  # can create short-lived keys for CI, no billing view
- role: workspace_viewer  # read-only
```
We can attach an expiry to service_account_runner keys and log uses.

maria (Sales): Pricing questions: if they bump to Dedicated for the 2 weeks, do we pro-rate reserved capacity?

ajay (SE): We can offer a time-limited Dedicated burst with a reduced commit and prorated invoice — sales to confirm exact numbers. For now tell them estimate: ~2 GPU-days/day baseline.

chris (ACME): For invites — send to chris@acme.com + eng team. Also our security team requires an "access justification" field on invites.

maria (Sales): noted. I'll add justification to invite text.

taylor (Infra): Quick VPC checklist for them:
- share VPC CIDR and allowed ports (443 outbound + ephemeral for control plane)
- if peering, add route to our service subnet
- if they want private controller: provide SSH bastion plan and KMS ARN

safiya (Security): Also add audit log retention (30 days min for POC) and enable eval-trigger alerts so we can watch regression during tests.

ajay (SE): I'll prepare a service account and a short-lived key now. maria, ping me with the email list.

maria (Sales): pinged — sending list now.

deploy-bot: dedicated_pool_provision request queued (req-id: dp-20260315-71). ETA 36h.

chris (ACME): great — rough ETA for initial hosted keys?

ajay (SE): I can create workspace invites + 48h keys in ~1h. Dedicated pool ETA per deploy-bot. VPC steps depend on their network team.

maria (Sales): action items: (1) maria send invite list + justification (2) ajay create short-lived keys + post in thread (3) taylor follow up if ACME needs VPC peering (4) safiya confirm audit settings. I'll handle prorated pricing calc with finance.

safiya (Security): ack. Please mark any keys as "POC" in metadata so we auto-delete after expiry.

ajay (SE): Will post the key and a minimal runbook (rotate/delete) once keys are generated.

maria (Sales): thanks all — i'll update chris once ajay posts keys. :thumbsup:
